stem: Find the momentum of the sports bike at the speed of 140 km/h.

modelAnswer: Mass of bike (m) = 325 kg, Velocity (v) = 140 km/h = 140 \times 1000 / 3600 = 38.89 m/s. Momentum P = m \times v = 325 \times 38.89 = 12639.25 kg m/s.

stem: Find the velocity of the car if momentum of both the vehicles is same.

rubric.description: Equating the momentum of car to the momentum of the bike
Rearranging the formula to solve for car's velocity
Correct calculation and unit for car's velocity

modelAnswer: Momentum of car = Momentum of bike = 12639.25 kg m/s. Mass of car = 1754 kg. Velocity of car = P / m = 12639.25 / 1754 = 7.21 m/s.

stem: Explain the reason, why upthrust acts in the upward direction.

rubric.description: Mentioning that pressure in a fluid increases with depth
Explaining that upward pressure at the bottom is greater than downward pressure at the top

modelAnswer: Pressure in a fluid increases with depth. Therefore, the upward force exerted by the fluid on the bottom of an immersed object is greater than the downward force exerted on the top, resulting in a net upward force called upthrust.
text: Explain the reason, why upthrust acts in the upward direction.
